name: workbench
description: Five explicit Workbench skills for standalone evidence-backed shaping and planning, optional Local Work Memory artifact persistence, task-scoped Git worktree execution, and integrated validation.

interface.shortDescription: Shape, prepare, optionally persist, and execute isolated tasks.
interface.longDescription: Workbench provides five independently invoked skills: shape a standalone change contract from repository and project evidence; prepare a standalone task DAG without creating worktrees; optionally persist selected Shape or Prepare results as immutable Local Work Memory artifacts; create one standard Git worktree per implementation or integration task; and finalize the clean integrated result with failure testing and independent review. Persistence is never required between workflow skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $workbench:shape to create a standalone sourced Shape Report for this change.
Use $workbench:prepare to turn this complete Shape Report into task worktree packets.
Use $workbench:execute-task to create and execute one ready task worktree.
